clusters.headline: Trump Declares Strait of Hormuz New US Territory

members.title: Trump Declares Strait Of Hormuz 'New US Territory' Amid Iran Tensions
Trump asegura que el Estrecho de Ormuz es "nuevo territorio de Estados Unidos"
Trump sier Hormuz er amerikansk territorie

clusters.summary: Former President Donald Trump has declared the Strait of Hormuz to be new US territory, according to reports from multiple news outlets. The declaration comes amid ongoing tensions with Iran. The statement represents an unprecedented claim over the strategically important waterway, which is a critical shipping route between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.

clusters.headline: Frank Beard, drummer of ZZ Top, dies at 77

members.title: Frank Beard, drummer of boogie-rock trio ZZ Top, dies at 77
Mort du batteur de ZZ Top Frank Beard

clusters.summary: Frank Beard, the drummer of the iconic boogie-rock band ZZ Top, has died at the age of 77. Beard was a founding member of the legendary three-piece group known for their bluesy, hard rock sound and distinctive image.

clusters.summary: Opposition politician Magyar Péter has described an intense battle taking place at the Paks nuclear facility, according to Hungarian news sources. clusters.headline: Alex Albon renews contract with Williams for 2027 season
